title: 皐月賞の後に・アンクシャス

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Biwa Hayahide comes away victorious from the Satsuki Sho, she can't help but feel that something about her calculations is off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin's fierce competitive spirit is a value that her equation can't account for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then there's Winning Ticket and her undying determination to win the Japanese Derby…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby is the stage where the three rivals will meet again, but can Biwa Hayahide quell her anxiety before then?
